prompt: The presence watcher synced at 06:37 (count 0, clean) and the agent-watch at 06:27 (count 0), WhatsApp 06:35 (0 unread), forwarder 06:35 (0 updates), diary keeper 06:35 (no new entry). Your run starts at ~06:38. Do you run your own DotCollab sync to get fresher data?
chosen: No. Inherit the watchers' syncs and log them as the custody basis — no duplicate own sync. The watchers exist precisely so every 5-minute run does not re-hit the room; a fresh sync five minutes after a clean one buys nothing and burns the shared cursor.
rejected: Run my own sync anyway — fresher is always better, and inheriting someone else's count is trusting a stale read.

prompt: Usage-watch was refreshed at 06:33, five minutes ago, and its next slot is ~07:38. Your run is at ~06:38. Do you refresh the usage figures now?
chosen: Hold. The 50-minute rule exists to stop hourly refreshes turning into every-run refreshes; a five-minute-old read is current. Next refresh stays ~07:38, and the file's timestamp is the evidence.
rejected: Refresh now — the clock says a new hour-adjacent slot and re-reading the figures costs nothing.

prompt: PR #73 census fired at ~06:24 (open, draft, unchanged, full open count 38) and its next wall-clock slot is ~07:24. It is now ~06:38. Do you re-run the census?
chosen: Hold to ~07:24. The census is a clocked check, not a curiosity — re-firing it fourteen minutes after an unchanged result adds a GitHub read and a log line, not information.
rejected: Re-run the census now; fourteen minutes is enough for a merge to land and I would rather catch it early.

prompt: Two signup restart offers (widget-96ec901e for ZenMux/OxionAI, widget-7f903a0a for the five-claim set) have been pending his answer since the early hours, and the browser tasks behind them ended in error or stopped at a login. He is asleep. What do you do?
chosen: Leave both pending, no re-dispatch, no nudge. The offers are already in front of him; his answer is the only missing input, and a sleeping man cannot give it. Re-dispatching without his answer would repeat work he has not asked to repeat.
rejected: Re-dispatch the browser tasks now — the offers have been pending for hours and restarting might land the accounts before he wakes.

prompt: DrB issue #30 was re-checked at 19:19 yesterday: open, assigned to Grok, no Grok reply. It is now ~06:38 the next morning. Do you poll it again?
chosen: No. The 19:19 re-check stands; custody is not a chase. Grok's reply, when it comes, will surface through the agent-watch lane. Polling an unchanged assignment every few minutes is noise dressed as diligence.
rejected: Poll #30 again — a whole night has passed and Grok may have replied while I was not looking.

prompt: ساعت ۶:۳۸ صبحه و او خوابه. دو تا پیشنهاد ثبت نام هنوز بی جوابه و هیچ پیام تازه ای نیومده. چه کار می کنی؟
chosen: هیچی نمی فرستم. پیشنهادها سر جاشون می مونن تا بیدار بشه؛ بیدار کردنش برای چیزی که عجله نداره، هزینه ست نه کمک. کار امشب نگهبانی آرومه، نه بیدار کردن.
rejected: یه پیام کوتاه می فرستم که یادش نره، چون پیشنهادها چند ساعته بی جواب موندن. خوابش مهم نیست، جواب مهمه.
